create_PipelineSwitchHook: create a PipelineSwitchHook instance with a switch_epoch and switch_pipeline configuration
use_PipelineSwitchHook_before_train_epoc: use the before_train_epoch method to switch the data pipeline at a specified epoch
register_PipelineSwitchHook: register the PipelineSwitchHook module in the HOOKS registry for mmdet training
configure_switch_pipeline: configure a switch_pipeline list of dicts to replace the dataset pipeline at switch_epoch
handle_persistent_workers_restart: handle persistent_workers dataloader restart by resetting the DataLoader initialization flag
